title: Economics
byZones: By zone (since the hub's last restart)
lifetimeEarned: Credit earned since net metering was on
lifetimeUsed: Credit used since net metering was on
noZoneCharges: No zone charges in this period.
closedOnly: From the hub’s closed records; the running hour is not included.
genNoData: No generation data for this period.
genExplain: “Not bought” = own solar use at the period's average buying price ({rate}).
genExplainNoRate: The value of own use appears once the input has money for the period.
todayByCounters: Today from the hub's day counters (as on the Overview), earlier days from closed records.
balanceIncomplete: The balance is incomplete — no data for the period at: {points}. The unmetered part is not counted until they are.
closedPast: From the hub's closed records (days checked against the hour records).
basicNoExport: A point on a BASIC module: it counts consumption only — no export, export value or net figures.
basicNoNetMetering: The input is on a BASIC module, which doesn't measure export — no net-metering credit accrues; the figures below were accumulated by the hub before.
